systems.system: mobile registration exercises under the EARLY action
systems.country_label: EARLY (Enhancing Access to Birth Registration and Legal Identity)
systems.owner: Births and Deaths Registry, with ICMPD under the EU-funded FMM West Africa Phase II project
systems.tiers: six regions: Ahafo, Bono, Bono-East, North-East, Oti and Upper-East

note: EU-funded training of more than 200 Registry and health staff, sensitisation and mobile registration exercises in six regions, and a Registry short-staffed in many districts; the 'tools that exist but are underused' are not named or described, and nothing says whether an office records a birth digitally or on paper.
